Definition: Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Berakah means "blessing." The name is shared by several bearers: A Benjamite, one of David's warriors; A valley in the wilderness near Tekoa where Jehoshaphat and his people assembled to bless Jehovah after the overthrow of the hosts of the Moabites. It turns up in 1 Chronicles 12:3 and 2 Chronicles 20:26.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Berakah is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
